risks.risk: Unknown exact model (affects value tier significantly for Yamaha keyboards)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model sticker/label, usually on the back or underside of the unit
risks.if_unproven: price as lowest-tier/entry-level Yamaha keyboard with no model confirmation

risks.proof: Video showing each key pressed and sounding, plus buttons/menu navigation
risks.if_unproven: price as if some keys/buttons are non-functional

risks.proof: Photo of the actual adapter alongside the keyboard, showing plug type and voltage rating

risks.risk: Speaker/sound quality and claimed absence of crackle unverified
risks.proof: Short audio/video clip of the keyboard playing at various volumes
risks.if_unproven: price as having faulty or uncertain speaker output

risks.risk: Physical condition of back, underside, and battery compartment unknown
risks.proof: Photos of the back, underside, and open battery compartment if applicable
risks.if_unproven: price as having unseen cosmetic/structural damage

risks.risk: Watermark 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' suggests photos may be reused from a dealer listing rather than the actual item in hand
risks.proof: Fresh, timestamped photo of the item with a handwritten note or current date visible
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified listing authenticity, treat as higher-risk private sale

proof_requests: Photo of the model number/label on the back or underside of the keyboard
Video of all keys being pressed with audible sound
Photo of the adapter included with the sale
Audio/video clip demonstrating speaker output at different volumes
Photos of the back, underside, and any battery compartment
A fresh photo of the item taken today without the reseller watermark
response.reason: The witness confirms a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced, but without model confirmation, functional proof, or adapter visibility, it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
